hook: Stem-cell neutrophils engineered to carry ACE cleared drug-resistant bacteria in neutropenic mice.
summary: Human stem cells engineered to express angiotensin-converting enzyme became neutrophils that killed MRSA and multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas better in the dish. Transferred into mice with too few neutrophils, they lowered bacterial loads in blood and tissue. It is early preclinical work in mice, and safety and durability in people are unknown.
title: ACE-engineered human iPSC-derived neutrophils enhance host defense against multidrug-resistant bacterial infections
